source.title: 2026 F&B Menu by Item (Green Bay Packers / Lambeau Field)

notes: Lambeau reconciliation against the official 2026 Packers F&B by Item gameday PDF, cross-checked with 2026 F&B Concepts by Stands. The audit snapshot used a concert by-item PDF; this payload prefers the gameday directory. Existing CSV headline rows are updated in place when the official SKU is clearly the same product. Uncertain and stale rows stay active. No prices are published in the official PDFs, so all basePrice values are null. Operator: Delaware North.

staleReview.evidence: Positive evidence: Bratcho is absent from the official 2026 gameday F&B by Item PDF and from the 2026 concert by-item PDF. CSV described tater tots with brat coins, which is not Jumbo Brat, Brat Eggroll, or Pack N Cheese Brat. Left active; do not auto-hide.
Positive evidence: not listed on the official 2026 gameday F&B by Item PDF. A similarly named sandwich appears only on the concert by-item PDF. Left active; do not auto-hide.

staleReview.existingName: Green and Gold BBQ Chicken Sandwich
staleReview.evidence: Positive evidence: that name is absent from the 2026 gameday by-item PDF. CSV locations 105-M, 133-M, 742-I overlap official Pulled Pork Sandwich locations, but the official SKU is pork, not chicken. Left active; do not auto-hide.
Positive evidence: Bento Box is not on the 2026 gameday by-item PDF. Club 427 is Melotte Marketplace, which lists Noodle Bow, Bahn Mi, pizza, and other SKUs instead. Left active; do not auto-hide.

Positive evidence: the official 2026 by-item PDF lists plated SKUs at 1919 stands (Brat-1919, Cheese Curds-1919, burgers) but not a food product named 1919 Kitchen & Tap. The row is a restaurant-as-item leftover from the CSV headline import. The vendor record is still valid (P111). Left active; do not auto-hide.

Positive evidence: this food item is a malformed CSV row (item name is the JTV concept; vendor is Fresh Cheese Curds). JTV is an official 2026 location/concept, not a plated SKU. A proper Johnsonville Tailgate Village vendor is created for JTV items. Left this row active; do not auto-hide.
Positive evidence: the 2026 gameday by-item PDF lists Gluten Free Bun at 116-O, not a Gluten-Free Markets food product at CSV sections 103, 116. Left active; do not auto-hide.
Positive evidence: $5 Value Items is a CSV heading, not an official 2026 plated SKU. Left active; do not auto-hide.
